## Overview

This project involved using Claude Code to develop a **scripture study companion app** with a distinctive "Illuminated Manuscript" aesthetic inspired by medieval religious texts. The app helps users track their daily study habits, read scriptures, create topical studies, and journal their spiritual insights.

The primary purpose of this app is to:

- Encourage consistent daily scripture study through streak tracking and visual progress
- Provide an organized way to read and navigate the Book of Mormon and Bible
- Enable topical study creation with scripture references and personal notes
- Offer a beautiful journaling experience for recording spiritual impressions

## Key Features

- **Study Streak Tracking**: Visual flame icon with animated glow effects, milestone celebrations, and longest streak records
- **Scripture Reader**: Hierarchical navigation through volumes, books, and chapters with elegant card-based UI
- **Guided Studies**: Create custom topical studies, add scripture references, and record study notes
- **Personal Journal**: Write entries with beautiful drop-cap styling and date formatting
- **Progress Dashboard**: Monthly calendar view, stats cards with gold shimmer animations, and activity history
- **Illuminated Manuscript Design**: Deep navy backgrounds, gold accents, Cormorant Garamond & Crimson Pro typography
- **Responsive Design**: Fully mobile-friendly with smooth animations and transitions
- **Local Storage Persistence**: All data saved locally for privacy and offline access

## Design Philosophy

The app draws inspiration from **medieval illuminated manuscripts**—hand-crafted religious texts featuring ornate borders, gilded lettering, and deep jewel tones. Key design elements include:

| Element | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| Typography | Cormorant Garamond (headings), Crimson Pro (body) |
| Color Palette | Midnight navy (#0a0f1a), Gold (#d4a853), Parchment (#f4e8d3) |
| Decorative Details | Corner ornaments, gradient borders, ornate dividers |
| Animations | Gold shimmer text, staggered fade-ins, flame flicker, pulse glow |
| Textures | Subtle noise overlay, radial gradient accents |

## Technical Details

**Framework/Stack:** React 19, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS 4

**Deployment:** Vercel

**Tools Used:**

- Claude Code for full development (design + implementation)
- Vite for fast development and optimized builds
- Tailwind CSS 4 with custom theme configuration
- React Router for client-side navigation
- localStorage for data persistence

## Product Requirements Document

### 1. Product Overview

**Product Name:** Scripture Study - Illuminated Companion
**Product Type:** Progressive Web Application
**Target Platform:** Web (desktop and mobile browsers)

### 2. Problem Statement

Scripture study is essential for spiritual growth, but many people struggle with:

- Maintaining consistent daily study habits
- Organizing insights across multiple scripture sources
- Tracking progress and staying motivated
- Finding a reverent, distraction-free study environment

### 3. Target Users

- Individuals seeking to deepen their scripture study practice
- Members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
- Anyone wanting to track spiritual study habits with beautiful design
- Users who appreciate thoughtful, reverent UI/UX

### 4. Core Features

#### 4.1 Streak Tracking
- **Daily check-in**: Mark study completion with one tap
- **Streak counter**: Visual display of consecutive study days
- **Milestone celebrations**: Special recognition at 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 100, 180, 365 days
- **Streak recovery**: Grace period logic for maintaining motivation

#### 4.2 Scripture Navigation
- **Volume selection**: Book of Mormon and Bible (KJV)
- **Book listing**: All books within each volume
- **Chapter grid**: Quick access to any chapter
- **Reading view**: Clean, distraction-free scripture display

#### 4.3 Guided Studies
- **Topic creation**: Name and organize study themes
- **Reference collection**: Add scripture references to each study
- **Personal notes**: Record insights for each topic
- **Study management**: Edit and delete studies as needed

#### 4.4 Journaling
- **Rich entries**: Title and content for each journal entry
- **Date tracking**: Automatic timestamp for all entries
- **Drop-cap styling**: Beautiful first-letter illumination
- **Entry management**: View, create, and delete entries

#### 4.5 Progress Visualization
- **Stats cards**: Current streak, longest streak, total days
- **Calendar view**: Monthly grid showing study days
- **Activity feed**: Recent study session history

### 5. Technical Requirements

| Requirement | Specification |
|-------------|---------------|
| Framework | React 19 with functional components and hooks |
| Build Tool | Vite 7 for fast HMR and optimized production builds |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS 4 with custom design tokens |
| Routing | React Router v7 for client-side navigation |
| State | React hooks + localStorage for persistence |
| Hosting | Vercel (serverless edge deployment) |
| Browser Support | Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) |

### 6. Success Metrics

- App loads in under 2 seconds
- Smooth 60fps animations on all devices
- Daily active user retention > 50%
- Mobile-responsive at all breakpoints
- Accessibility score > 90 (Lighthouse)

### 7. Development Approach

Built using **Claude Code** as an AI pair-programming assistant to:

- Design and implement a distinctive visual aesthetic
- Create reusable React components with proper state management
- Build custom hooks for data persistence
- Implement responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS
- Add meaningful animations and micro-interactions
